data.reasoning: The deepseek model successfully reviewed all package files (PKGBUILD, .SRCINFO, and stremio-enhanced.sh) and correctly identified them as standard, safe AUR packaging for a prebuilt Electron application. The qwen model's inconclusive verdict was solely due to a transient API error (HTTP 400) when attempting to review the launcher script, not due to any actual security concerns.
data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement is an artifact of a tool error. The qwen model failed to audit stremio-enhanced.sh due to an LLM API error (HTTP 400 BadRequestError), forcing an inconclusive package verdict. The deepseek model reviewed the exact same file without issue and found it to be a benign Electron launcher script.
coverage_issues: qwen model failed to review stremio-enhanced.sh due to an LLM API error (HTTP 400).
learnings: Implement retry logic or fallback mechanisms for transient LLM API errors (like HTTP 400) to prevent a single file's audit failure from rendering the entire package inconclusive.
